z-m-40-07.title: Haddii aan kor u qaadno xariiqda jiifka ah, dhibcaha is-goysyadu ma kordhaan oo keliya?
z-m-40-07.topic: Garaafka laba-jibaarka leh qiimaha saafiga ah y=|x²−4| iyo sida tirada is-goysyada xariiq jiifa ay u beddelanto
z-m-40-07.goal: Sharax sababta tirada is-goysyadu aysan u sii kordhayn oo keliya laakiin ay u beddelanto marka dhererka k ee xariiqda jiifka ah uu is beddelo, adigoo ku xirayo qaabka garaafka (dusha laablaabmay iyo dhibicda taabata dhidibka x).
z-m-40-07.material: Tirada dhibcaha garaafka howsha y = |x² − 4| (loo akhriyo: 'qiimaha saafiga ah ee x labajibaaran laga jaray 4') uu kulmo xariiqda jiifka ah y = k waxay la mid tahay tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan ee isleegga |x² − 4| = k. Hoose waa qiimayaasha y ee la xisaabiyey qiimayaal x qaar. Marka x tahay −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y waa 5, 0, 3, 4, 3, 0, 5.
z-m-40-07.thinking.0: Samaynta saadaal, ku hubinta xisaabin, oo dib u eegista
z-m-40-07.thinking.1: Helista qiimayaasha k ee u adeega xudduudo
z-m-40-07.thinking.2: Isku xirka qaabka garaafka iyo tirada xididdada
z-m-40-07.prereq.0: Heerka loo meeleeyey H3 waa heer adkaansho oo qaybintan soo saarista ah oo keliya, mana aha in manhajku meelaynayo waxyaabahan fasal gaar ah. Malo-awaal: waxaad hore u taqaanaa garaafka howsha laba-jibaaran, macnaha qiimaha saafiga ah, iyo tarjumaadda ah xididdada dhabta ah ee isleegga waa dhibcaha is-goysyada garaafka iyo xariiq jiifa.
z-m-40-07.prereq.1: Xalalka isleegga laba-jibaaran x² = m (laba haddii m > 0, hal haddii m = 0, midna haddii m < 0)
z-m-40-07.prereq.2: Qiimaha saafiga ah |t| waa t haddii t ≥ 0 iyo −t haddii t < 0
z-m-40-07.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa marka k is beddelo. Mar kasta, dooro tirada dhibcaha is-goysyada.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.0: Raac qiimayaasha shaxda, oo tiri imisa jeer ayuu garaafku dhaafaa meesha y = k, hal u dhexeyn mar.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.1: U kala qaybi labada isleeg x² − 4 = k iyo x² − 4 = −k, oo xalli imisa x ayaa mid walba ka soo baxa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Marka hore, sawir xariiqda jiifka ah y = 1, oo k = 1.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Imisa dhibcood oo kala duwan ayaa xariiqda jiifka ah y = 1 la wadaagaa garaafka?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.after: |x² − 4| = 1 macnaheedu waa x² − 4 = 1 ama x² − 4 = −1, sidaas darteed x² = 5 ama x² = 3. x = ±√5, ±√3, taas oo ah 4 dhibcood. Shaxda dhexdeeda, qiimayaashu way hoos u dhacaan x = 1 (y = 3) ilaa x = 2 (y = 0), oo way kacaan x = 2 ilaa x = 3 (y = 5), sidaas darteed dhinaca midig wuxuu ka gudbaa y = 1 laba jeer, dhinaca bidixna waa sidaas.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kani waa fikir ah wuxuu kulmaa hal lammaane oo keliya, bidix iyo midig, sida parabola.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kani waa fikir ah, raacidda qaabka qiimayaasha shaxda ee hoos u dhacaya kadibna kacaya, wuxuu ka gudbaa laba jeer dhinac kasta bidix iyo midig.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kani waa fikir ah, qaabka taabanaya dhidibka x awgeed, hal dhibic oo kale ayaa lagu daraa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kani waa fikir ah, maadaama shaxda aysan ku jirin x oo y = 1, ma kulmaan. Ka fikir qiimayaasha shaxda gelitaankeeda dhexdooda ah.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Markan, sawir xariiqda jiifka ah y = 4, oo k = 4. Shaxda dhexdeeda, y = 4 marka x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Imisa dhibcood oo kala duwan ayaa xariiqda jiifka ah y = 4 la wadaagaa garaafka?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Laga bilaabo x² − 4 = 4, x = ±2√2 (2 bar), iyo laga bilaabo x² − 4 = −4, x = 0 (1 bar), iyagana ma is raacaan, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 3 wadar ahaan. k = 4 waa dhererka dhibcaha ugu sarreeya ee qaybta kor loo laabay x = 0, sidaa darteed xariijinta jiifku si dhib yar ayay dhibcaha ugu sarreeya u taabataa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tani waa fikir ah in tirada ay isku mid tahay xataa haddii k is beddelo.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tani waa fikir seegtay taabashada hal mar x = 0 oo tiriyey kaliya labada bar ee dibadda ah.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Tani waa fikir isla tiriyey hal barta taabashada x = 0 iyo labada bar ee dibadda ah.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Tani waa fikir ah, sababtoo ah k wuu weynaaday, isgoysyadu sidoo kale way kordhaan.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Ugu dambeyn, sawir xariijinta jiifta y = 5, leh k = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Imisa bar oo kala duwan ayay xariijinta jiifta y = 5 la wadaagtaa garaafka?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Laga bilaabo x² − 4 = 5, x = ±3 (2 bar), iyo x² − 4 = −5 macnaheedu waa x² = −1, kaas oo aan lahayn xidid dhab ah. Waxaa jira 2 wadar ahaan. Marka k ka weynaado 4, xariijinta jiifta waxay kor u kacdaa dhibcaha ugu sarreeya ee la laabay, labada laan ee dibadda ah oo keliya ayaa haraya.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tani waa fikir ah markii aad k sii kor u qaaddo, isgoysyo badan ayaa jira.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tani waa fikir qaadanaya tirada marka k = 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waa fikir ah, maadaama ay dhaafeen dhererka ugu sarreeya 4, mar dambe ma kulmaan. Hubi haddii ay shaxda ku jirto x leh y = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tani waa fikir ah marka ay kor u kacdo dhibcaha ugu sarreeya ee la laabay, waxay kulantaa labada meel ee dibadda ah oo keliya.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.reflect: Ma u malaysay isgoysyadu kaliya inay kordhaan marka k kor loo qaado? Sharax sababta, marka k laga kor qaado qiime aad u yar, tirada isgoysyadu u beddelanto sida 0 → 2 → 4 → 3 → 2, adigoo ku xidhaya baraha garaafka ee taabta dhidibka x iyo dhibcaha ugu sarreeya ee la laabay.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.prompt: Marka k si tartiib ah looga kor qaado tiro taban oo aad u yar, qor dhammaan qiimayaasha xadka ee k halka tirada isgoysyadu is beddesho, oo sharax qaybta garaafka ee xariijinta jiiftu maraysaa xad kasta.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.0: Shaxda ku hel qiimaha ugu yar ee y iyo dhererka qaybta la laabay agtiisa x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.1: Dhig k wax yar ka hooseeya iyo wax yar ka sarreeya xad, oo isbarbar dhig tirooyinka isgoysyada.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday sababta qiimayaasha xadka k ay u yihiin qiimayaashaas, iyo dhererka barta kee ee garaafka ay yihiin?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Xad kasta agtiisa (marka k ka yar yahay xadka iyo marka ka weyn yahay), ma sheegtay imisa isgoys ayaa jira?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.0: Xadadku waa k=0 iyo k=4. k=0 waa dhererka x=±2, halka xariijinta jiiftu taabato dhidibka x, marka ay kor u gudubto taas, waxaa jira 4 isgoys. k=4 waa dhibcaha ugu sarreeya ee la laabay x=0, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 3 markaas, marka ay ka weynaato 4 na kaliya 2 ayaa haraya.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.1: Marka aad kor u qaaddo xariijinta jiifta, marka hore waxay taabataa garaafka k=0 (2 isgoys), 0 iyo 4 dhexdooda waxaa jira 4, k=4 waxay marta dhibcaha ugu sarreeya x=0 waxaana jira 3, marka k ka weyn tahay 4 na waxay kulantaa labada meel ee dibadda ah oo keliya, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 2. Sidaa darteed qiimayaasha beddelaya waa 0 iyo 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Tani waa jawaab ay ku jirto sidoo kale xaaladda 0 bar marka k < 0.

z-m-40-04.title: Safar wareeg ah, imisa ayay dhakhso u tahay inuu noqdo soo laabashadu si celceliska xawaaraha uu u noqdo?
z-m-40-04.topic: Celceliska xawaaraha safar wareeg ah oo lagu muujiyay shaqo saami ah: sida uu u beddelmo xawaaraha soo laabashada, iyo xadkiisa
z-m-40-04.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya waqtiyo hubi in celceliska xawaaraha safar wareeg ah aanay ahayn celceliska xisaabeed ee xawaaraha, eeg xadka celceliska xitaa haddii xawaaraha soo laabashada la kordhiyo saadaalin iyo xisaab, kadibna adigu hel xawaaraha buuxiya shuruudda.
z-m-40-04.material: Baska ayaa safar wareeg ah ku sameeya isla wadada. Tagitaanka wuxuu ku socdaa xawaare joogto ah 30 km saacaddii, soo laabashada-na wuxuu ku socdaa xawaare joogto ah x km saacaddii. Masaafada hal dhinac ah D km lama ogayn, wax istaagna ma jiraan wadada. Celceliska xawaaraha waxaa loo qeexay (wadarta masaafada la socdaalay) ÷ (wadarta waqtiga la qaatay).
z-m-40-04.thinking.0: Dib u eegidda saadaal dareen ah macluumaad cusub
z-m-40-04.thinking.1: Akhrinta qaabka isbeddelka (weyn marka hore, kadibna yaraanaya oo sii yaraanaya)
z-m-40-04.prereq.0: Heerka H3 ee loo qoondeeyay waa heer adkaan oo qaybintan soo saarka ah oo keliya, mana ay macnaheedu yahay in manhajku nuxurkan dhigo fasal gaar ah. Male-awaal: waad taqaan xawaare = masaafo ÷ waqti iyo sida loogu xisaabiyo odhaahyada jajabka.
z-m-40-04.prereq.1: Xisaabinta odhaahyada saamiga ah (jajabka), iyo dareenka ah jajab wuu yaraadaa marka hooseeyihiisu weynaado
z-m-40-04.prereq.2: Heshiiska ah celceliska xawaaraha = wadarta masaafada ÷ wadarta waqtiga la qaatay
z-m-40-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Mar kasta, dooro waxa celceliska xawaaraha safarka wareegga ahi noqon doono.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hagaaji masaafada hal dhinac ah qiime gaar ah sida 60 km, oo si gooni ah hel waqtiga tagitaanka iyo soo laabashada qaadatay.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kadib helidda masaafada safarka wareegga ah iyo wadarta waqtiga la qaatay, tijaabi haddii natiijadu beddelanto marka masaafada hal dhinac ah loo beddelo qiime kale.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.info: U qaado maalinta xawaaraha soo laabashadu ahaa 60 km saacaddii tusaale ahaan. Masaafada hal dhinac ah D weli lama ogin.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maalintan celceliska xawaaraha safarka wareegga ahi waa imisa?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii D = 60 km, tagitaanku wuxuu qaadanayaa 60 ÷ 30 = 2 saacadood soo laabashada-na wuxuu qaadanayaa 60 ÷ 60 = 1 saac, sidaas darteed safar wareeg ah oo 120 km ah wuxuu qaatay 3 saacadood. Celceliska xawaaraha waa 120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h. Isla natiijo ayaa soo baxda qiimayaasha kale ee D (D wuu baaba'aa). Waa ka yar 45 sababtoo ah waqtiga badan ayaa lagu qaatay socodka xawaaraha gaabis ah.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kani waa fikir u qaadanaya celceliska xisaabeed ee xawaaraha (dhexda 30 iyo 60) sida celceliska xawaaraha.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kani waa fikir tixgelinaya in waqtiga badan lagu qaatay socodka xawaaraha gaabis ah.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kani waa fikir ah qaybta dhakhsaha badan waxay leedahay saamayn ka weyn. Barbar dhig waqtiga qayb kasta la qaatay.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ma ognin D, sidaas darteed ma ogaan karno celceliska xawaaraha sidoo kale
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kani waa fikir ah waad xisaabin kartaa haddii masaafadu gaar tahay. Isku day inaad D ka dhigto 60 oo barbar dhig qiimayaasha kale.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Eeg maalinta xawaaraha soo laabashada loo kordhiyay 120 km saacaddii.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Xawaaraha soo laabashada wuu labalaabmay (60 → 120). Sidee ayuu celceliska xawaaruhu uga beddelmi doonaa 40 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii D = 120 km, tagitaanku wuxuu qaadanayaa 4 saacadood soo laabashada-na wuxuu qaadanayaa 1 saac, sidaas darteed wadarta waa 240 ÷ 5 = 48 km/h. Inkasta oo xawaaraha la labalaabay, celcelisku wuxuu kordhay 20% oo keliya. Tani waa sababtoo ah waqtiga tagitaanka qaatay waa isku mid, sidaas darteed wadarta waqtigu ma hoos u dhacayo badh.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wuxuu kordhaa ilaa ku dhawaad laba jibaar, oo u dhow 80 km/saacaddii
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kani waa fikir ah haddii xawaaraha soo noqoshada uu labanlaabmo, celceliska sidoo kale wuu labanlaabmayaa si isku mid ah.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Celceliska xawaaraha wax badan ma beddelmo wuxuuna ku sii jiraa ku dhawaad 40
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kani waa fikir ah isbeddelka xawaaraha soo noqoshada wax yar ayuu saameeyaa celceliska.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Wuxuu ka kordhaa 40 laakiin kama gaaro labanlaabid
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kani waa fikir tixgelinaya in waqtiga loo qaatay tagitaanka uu sidiisa ahaado.

z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Haddii loo malaynayo xawaaraha soo noqoshada la weynayn karo sida la rabo, ma suurtagal baa celceliska xawaaraha safarka tagitaanka iyo soo noqoshada inuu gaaro 60 km saacaddii?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Celceliska xawaaraha waa 60x ÷ (30 + x). Waqtiga tagitaanka mar hore ayaa la isticmaalay, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii waqtiga soo noqoshada loo dhawaysiiyo 0, celceliska wuxuu u dhawaanayaa 2D ÷ (D/30) = 60 mana gaaro. z-m-40-05.title: Howl xidid ah oo dhammaadkeedu yahay (−2, 1): ma jirtaa hal qaacido oo keliya?
z-m-40-05.topic: Howsha xididka y=√(ax+b)+c: xorriyadda hadhay marka qaacidada lagu hagaajiyo macluumaadka dhammaadka
z-m-40-05.goal: Xukun imisa joogto oo howl xidid ah ayuu macluumaadka hal dhammaad go'aamiyaa iyo imisa uu ka tagaa, adigu naftaada dhis qaabab kala duwan oo buuxiya shuruudda, oo sharax waxa dheeraadka ah ee loo baahan yahay si qalooca si gaar ah loo go'aamiyo.
z-m-40-05.material: Shaashadda fasalka, garaafka howsha xididka y = √(ax + b) + c (loo akhriyo: 'xididka labajibaaran ee a x lagu daray b, lagu daray c') ayaa soo muuqday. Qaloocu wuxuu leeyahay dhammaadkiisa bidix (−2, 1) wuxuuna halkaas ka fidaa xagga midig-sare. a, b, c waa joogto, maadaama uu xagga midig u fidayo, a > 0. Lama yaqaan dhibcaha kale ee qaloocu dhex maro.

z-m-40-01.title: Aan dooranno aag si shaqo rogan ay u jirto
z-m-40-01.topic: Is waafaqid hal-hal ah iyo shaqooyin rogan: yaraynta aagga ilaa xad si f(x)=x²−2x ay u yeelato shaqo rogan
z-m-40-01.goal: Garo in jadwal hubinaya dhowr qiimood aanu ahayn caddayn “hal-hal ah”, naqshadee xad adigu aagga shaqo labajibbaaran si isla qiime aanu u dhicin laba jeer, ka dibna xaqiiji in aagga shaqada rogan uu yahay xadka shaqada asalka ah.
z-m-40-01.material: Ka fikir shaqada f(x) = x² − 2x (akhri: 'x labajibbaaran laga jaray 2x'). Aagga weli lama dooran. Sheegidda f leedahay shaqo rogan urur gaar ah macnaheedu waa laba x oo kala duwan urur kaas ka tirsan ma bixiyaan isla qiimaha f (markaas xadka f wuxuu noqdaa aagga shaqada rogan). Seojin wuxuu sameeyay jadwal halka f(x) uu ahaa −1, 0, 3, 8 marka x = 1, 2, 3, 4, dhammaantood kala duwan, wuxuuna yiri, “f wuxuu leeyahay shaqo rogan dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah.”

z-m-40-01.s.s1.explain: Jadwalku wuxuu muujinayaa oo keliya in isla qiime aanu ka soo muuqan x = 1, 2, 3, 4. Ma ognin x jadwalka ka baxsan, run ahaanna waxaa jira x leh isla qiime, sida f(0) = 0 = f(2). Hubinta tiro xaddidan oo dhibcood ah ma go'aamiso in dhammaan ay yihiin hal-ka-hal.

z-m-40-03.title: Haddii qaacidooyinku isku mid u eg yihiin, garaafyadu sidoo kale ma isku mid yihiin?
z-m-40-03.topic: Dib u qorista shaqooyinka saamiga ah iyo qaybahooda: barbar dhigidda garaafyada (x²−1)/(x−1) iyo x+1
z-m-40-03.goal: Fahan in laba odhaah oo u eg isku mid kadib fududaynta loogu yeedho isla shaqo, qaybahoodu sidoo kale waa inay isku mid yihiin, oo kiis-kiis ugu sheeg goorta ay fiican tahay in loo sawiro isla garaaf iyo goorta aan sidaas ahayn.
z-m-40-03.material: Waxaa jira laba shaqo f(x) = (x² − 1)/(x − 1) iyo g(x) = x + 1. (Waxaa loo akhriyaa: 'x labajibbaaran ka jar 1, loo qaybiyay x ka jar 1'.) Haddii qayb si gooni ah aan loo qorin, waxaan u qaadanaa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah ee odhaahda lagu xisaabin karo. Jia wuxuu yidhi, “Tirinta x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1), haddii aad baabi'iso, wuxuu noqonayaa x + 1, sidaas darteed f iyo g waa isla shaqo garaafyadooduna waa isku mid.”

z-m-40-06.title: Maxaa laga baahan yahay si is-waafajin laga sameeyay qaybo isku xidhan ay u noqoto mid-mid?

Aagga iyo codomain labaduba waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah.

z-m-40-09.title: Laba tuulo iyo saddex tuulo, xaggee ayaa halka joogsiga baska la dhigaa?
z-m-40-09.topic: Wadarka hawlaha qiimaha saxda ah: garaafka xariijinta jebinaysa ee wadarka masaafooyinka S(x) iyo halka uu ugu yar yahay
z-m-40-09.goal: Fahan in wadarka masaafooyinka ilaa laba tuulo uu leeyahay hoose siman, sidaa darteed booska ugu yaraanta waa meelo badan, xaqiiji in saddex tuulo booska ugu yaraanta ay ku go'an tahay hal meel, oo naftaada u sii-sheeg xaaladda afar tuulo.
z-m-40-09.material: Waddo toosan, boosaska waxaa lagu muujiyaa x km. Tuulada A waxay joogtaa x = 2 tuulada B na x = 6. Waxaan rabnaa inaan dhisno hal joogsi baska booska x ee waddada. Haddii wadarka masaafooyinka laga bilaabo joogsiga ilaa tuulo kasta uu yahay S(x), markaas S(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6|. (Akhri sida: 'qiimaha saxda ah ee x laga jaray 2, ku dar qiimaha saxda ah ee x laga jaray 6'.) Joogsiga waxaa la dhisi karaa meel kasta oo waddada ah.

Malo-awaal: horey ayaad u taqaan tarjumaadda ah qiimaha saxda ah |x − p| uu yahay masaafada u dhexeysa x iyo p xariijinta tirooyinka.

z-m-40-10.title: Haddii qiimayaasha shaxda ay isle'eg yihiin bidix iyo midig, ma garaafku sidoo kale waa isku-simanaan?
z-m-40-10.topic: Isku-simanaanta garaafka hawlaha dhidibka y: xoogga caddaynta ah dhowr lammaane oo qiimayaal ah inay isle'eg yihiin, iyo dhisidda tusaalayaal lid ku ah

z-m-40-10.material: Qaacidada hawsha f lama yaqaan, waxaana jira shax qiimayaal leh x yar oo keliya. Marka x yahay −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, f(x) waa 4, 1, 0, 1, 4. Qiimayaasha x aan shaxda ku jirin lama yaqaan. Goobtu waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah, “isku-simanaan dhidibka y” na macnaheedu waa f(−x) = f(x) tiro dhab ah x kasta. Jiho wuxuu yiri, “Shaxda qiimayaasha x iyo −x waa isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed garaafka f waa isku-simanaan dhidibka y.”
